title: Practice layout.css 404 + translateSupportOptionAction POST 500
symptom: Console layout.css 404 and POST /practice 500 when clicking answer option
root_cause: Stale Next.js dev/HMR: CSS chunk 404 + server action ID mismatch; heavy actions.ts bundle; phrase cache RLS authenticated-only
fix: Split phrase-actions.ts; known phrase short-circuit + LLM timeout + local fallback; anon read RLS migration; AppShell Link nav
verification: MCP RLS anon read policy: PASS

title: Published case missing from Practice Case Bank (PGRST201)
symptom: Performance Review published case not shown in /practice; only seed case visible
root_cause: Ambiguous PostgREST embed learning_cases(...) caused PGRST201; listPublishedCases silently fell back to seedCaseBank
fix: Use learning_cases!learning_case_versions_case_id_fkey(...) FK hint; return [] on query error instead of seed
verification: anon REST curl with FK hint: PASS

title: Generate candidate Unauthorized (no auth session)
symptom: Admin Cases Generate Candidate button fails with Unauthorized
root_cause: enqueue_case_candidate requires auth.uid() but app had no login flow; is_admin_or_reviewer ignored profiles.role
fix: Added /login, admin route middleware guard, profile bootstrap, current_app_role reads profiles.role, requireAdminSession in admin actions

title: Ollama Cloud model 403 subscription required
symptom: Edge smoke invoke returns HTTP 500 with Ollama HTTP 403 subscription required for qwen3.5:397b
root_cause: OLLAMA_MODEL set to Pro-tier cloud model on Free Ollama account
fix: Changed OLLAMA_MODEL secret to gpt-oss:20b (Free tier level-1 model); both practice_coach and case_enrichment smoke PASS

title: Ollama gateway smoke failed on default localhost endpoint
symptom: Edge function learning-llm-gateway return HTTP 500 saat smoke invoke setelah deploy
root_cause: Secret OLLAMA_BASE_URL belum menunjuk endpoint Ollama yang reachable dari Supabase runtime (fallback localhost connection refused)
fix: Set OLLAMA_BASE_URL=https://ollama.com with API key; fallback-safe orchestration for speaking/case enrichment
verification: npx supabase functions deploy learning-llm-gateway: PASS
Edge invoke smoke after Option A + gpt-oss:20b: PASS

title: Speaking evaluator drift vs server state
symptom: Feedback speaking di client berpotensi beda dengan status sesi di server karena evaluasi lokal berjalan paralel
root_cause: Dual source-of-truth: heuristic evaluator di client dan evaluator persistence di server action
fix: Made server evaluation authoritative in speaking flow and aligned completion handling with persisted session status

title: PNG logo source-of-truth alignment
symptom: Branding masih memakai placeholder dan aset non-final sementara source logo final adalah PNG user
root_cause: Belum ada standardisasi satu aset logo di public/branding lintas shell, marketing, icon, dan watermark
fix: Added public/branding/bolo-bule-logo.png and replaced logo references in shell, marketing, metadata, and global watermark

title: AppShell dashboard webpack_require__.n dev crash
symptom: TypeError __webpack_require__.n is not a function on dashboard routes in AppShell.tsx dev
root_cause: Webpack dev HMR race on next/link default import interop
fix: Replaced Link with anchor + router.push; import type PropsWithChildren; cleared .next cache

title: Migration index references missing column
symptom: db push failed with SQLSTATE 42703 on learning_case_versions_status_idx
root_cause: Index targeted column domain that does not exist on learning_case_versions
fix: Changed index to use status, internal_level, case_id and re-ran db push
